goal: Protect nodes from memory exhaustion attacks through the orphan transaction pool
Enforce true memory bounds on transactions whose heap allocation drastically exceeds accounted weight
agreement: Verified by testing that memory-heavy orphans are properly evicted under simulated attack (jeanpablojp)
Resolved concerns about BitVM breakage and search memory spikes with lazy deserialization (instagibbs)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, Crypt-iQ)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it eliminates an unmetered memory exhaustion attack vector from peers in the orphan pool
Peers can otherwise bypass memory limits by 28x using standard-weight transactions with tiny witness items
